items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach/sources, but same knee had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery faster than expected; Kubiak positive but prior knee issues
items.implication: Monitor practice; stash TE1 if available, Mayer temporary fill-in
items.opportunity: If active, immediate TE1 usage; reverse Mayer beneficiaries

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; will monitor throughout week before deciding Week 2 availability vs Raiders. Status up in the air.
items.why: Rib injury from hit; further testing, Harbaugh cautious
items.implication: High risk sit Week 2; plan alternatives
items.opportunity: If OUT, boosts Quentin Johnston / other LAC WRs targets/routes

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI pending. Would likely have returned if playoff game. Coach Minter optimistic but monitor re-aggravation risk.
items.why: Hamstring tweak after 5-150-1 first half; prior camp issue but not serious
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 vs Saints but limited/risk; elite if full
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, Ja'Kobi Lane already longer-term wrist; other Ravens WRs

items.text: Sunday injury watch: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest/rib), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle). Earlier: Love/Odunze expected, Kamara not, Nabers pending.
items.why: Post-game exits and pre-game statuses requiring week monitoring
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUT players (e.g. Etienne if Kamara out)

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT just 4.9 (2.5 last night); only 2 targets for 7% share but ran 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd behind Worthy 30). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: High route participation but microscopic target share and aDOT
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex until volume materializes; scheme-dependent

items.text: Kenneth Walker operated as true workhorse in KC debut: handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 receiving.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving role as expected in new offense
items.implication: Lock-in RB1 with elite volume floor and ceiling
items.opportunity: 29/32 RB opps, 19 routes, 22% target share, goal-line implied

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgts, 156 yfs, 2 TDs. Utilization score 99 tied Bijan. Bullish ROS with scheme/OL improvements.
items.why: Every-down role + efficiency jump in Kubiak scheme
items.implication: Start as RB1 every week; hold through any regression

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: even with Kamara out, only 58% snaps/43% attempts/38% routes in 3-way committee. 16% targets helped but volume muted despite high play count.
items.why: Committee even without Kamara; route share low
items.implication: Flex/RB2 risk; Kamara return further clouds
items.opportunity: Limited; reverse if Kamara OUT again
items.conflict: Preseason lead-back expectation vs actual split

items.text: A.J. Brown (ankle) placed on IR, expected miss ~6 weeks per reports. Significant WR injury early.
items.implication: Sit ROS short-term; NE WR depth boosts others
items.opportunity: Targets free up for remaining NE pass-catchers

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme target/opportunity concentration on core four
items.implication: All four locked starters; ignore depth pieces

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid if not elite box score: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes/7 targets (all caught). Only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great CLE matchup next.
items.why: GL work, route edge over Gainwell, healthy post-camp questions

items.text: David Montgomery upgrades to high-end RB2: 65% rush attempts (all inside-5), short-yardage lead despite 50/50 snap reports. 28.9 PPR with 3 TDs; utilization supports low-end RB1/high RB2.
items.why: Clear early-down/GL back in split; efficient role
items.implication: Reliable starter; Marks for two-minute only

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Low passing-down involvement despite backup injury
items.implication: RB2/flex with limited upside; pass-game non-factor

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE for Cardinals; risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere. Team wouldn't activate if major injury worry (though Cardinals). Upside as lead eventually.
items.why: Cleared ankle; started and scored, shared work
items.implication: Start as RB2/flex with RB1 upside ROS
items.opportunity: Growing role vs Allgeier; short-yardage shared
